_note: perf-verifier's checked-in routing corpus — the test of record. POSITIVES cover the verify/check/audit-my-UI-for-perceived-performance families across phrasing (loading skeleton vs spinner vs optimistic, perceived-latency feedback windows, streaming UX, layout-stability / CLS budgets, image-dimension reservation, cancellation, stale-while-revalidate, perf budgets). NEGATIVES are ADVERSARIAL: the OTHER FOUR sibling verifiers' concerns (each a NEGATIVE here, labelled with the owning sibling), plus color-science (color theory/math) and component-decomposer (BUILDING a control, not verifying its loading UX). NOTE: this skill owns PERCEIVED latency (presentation), not back-end wire latency or JS bundle-size profiling — those are out of corridor. routing-eval measures lexical overlap only; a paraphrase positive may score recall 0 (proxy limit, not a defect).
positives: verify my loading UX uses the right skeleton vs spinner decision
check the CLS budget so content does not reflow as data arrives
audit perceived latency on this async surface against the threshold table
this feels slow even though the server is fast, check the presentation
verify my streaming response renders progressively with no flash at the end
should this mutation be optimistic and is rollback declared
check that images and media reserve layout space with dimensions or aspect-ratio
verify long operations over 10s expose a cancel affordance
audit the feedback recipe per async operation against the latency windows
is my layout stability within the 0.1 CLS budget per interaction
verify stale-while-revalidate marks cached data instead of blanking it
check that I am not showing a fake progress bar that fabricates percentages
verify aria-live during streaming is chunked, not announced per token
audit my UI for the skeleton-reserves-space and spinner-does-not rule

check the contrast ratio of my button text against its background (color-verifier)
audit my color scheme for color-blind safety (color-verifier)

audit the focus-ring appearance and keyboard operability (focus-verifier)
